hooks.command: diff -q "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/mcp-server/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/mcp-server/package.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (mkdir -p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/mcp-server" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/mcp-server/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/mcp-server/" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/mcp-server/package-lock.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/mcp-server/" 2>/dev/null; cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/mcp-server" && npm install --production) || rm -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/mcp-server/package.json"
